title: Growless Cave
wikitext:
[[Image:Growless Cave.jpg|thumb|Growless Cave]]
'''Growless Cave''' is a cave in the [[Alterac Mountains]] home to [[yeti]].  Inside is the Flame of Uzel, a ceremonial pyre created by the Forsaken, [[Helcular]].  The powerful yeti [[Frostmaw]] will approach the cave if meat is burned upon the Flame of Uzel.
